integrity: The universal formula is proved by an exhaustive classification of subgroups and an exact coset count. The elementary-abelian specialization is derived from Gaussian-binomial intersection counts, and its asymptotics follow from leading-degree optimization. Bounded computation is used only as a replay.
scientific_limitations: The exact formula is proved for finite abelian kernels of odd order.
Even-order kernels require additional terms caused by 2-torsion in quotient groups.
The elementary-abelian asymptotics hold for fixed rank while the odd prime tends to infinity.
An equivalent formula may exist under different terminology or in unindexed literature.
title: Subgroup commutativity of odd generalized dihedral groups
